method: Sequential fresh process per delivery module, then a separate fresh public-edition process; existing bench/profile_delivery_tests.py worker with discovery redirected to v0.5/scripts for edition. perf_counter includes setup, method and cleanup. No concurrent workspace test workloads. Canonical automatic Git maintenance disabled.
limits: One sample per canonical execution is candidate screening, not a stable median.
Seven imported checkpoint IDs are discovered in two delivery modules; their occurrences are retained and labeled separately.
Four privileged watcher tests failed before useful timing and are excluded from ranking.
This is not a complete successful full-suite timing baseline.
CLI validation scripts outside the two canonical unittest groups are outside this per-test ranking.
No optimization or additional reviewed-test designation is made by profiling.

excluded.reason: Monitor startup blocked before readiness; fanotify initialization returns EPERM in this non-root sandbox. Passing privileged CI validates correctness but supplies no comparable per-test timing.
